concept: Use case ui-mockup. Create one polished 16:9 complete PAUSE/SETTINGS game menu concept for a cozy fantasy red panda shop game. Match attached established foliage UI: deep forest green textured frame, restrained aged bronze gold outlines, cream parchment panels, tiny olive leaves at corners, elegant legible Chinese serif. Dimmed blurred isometric warm wooden shop in background. Large centered modal about 83% width 86% height. Header 设置 upper left, tiny leaf emblem, X close upper right. Left vertical navigation about 20% width with four clearly spaced tabs: 综合设置 (selected), 画面设置, 操作与按键, 存档管理. Right large parchment content area shows title 综合设置 then tidy setting rows with labels left and controls right: 界面语言 with dropdown 简体中文 and small chevron; 主音量 with slider at 80% and value 80%; 音乐音量 slider 60%; 音效音量 slider 85%; 窗口模式 dropdown 无边框窗口; 垂直同步 checked square checkbox. Each setting row has good spacing and a fine separator, no decorative clutter over words. Sliders dark green recessed tracks, fine gold borders, green-gold fill, small round bronze thumb with subtle leaf etching, all coherent visual style. Bottom footer outside parchment has FOUR distinct buttons: 返回游戏 prominent green-gold, 保存游戏, 读取存档 neutral bronze/parchment, 退出游戏 muted burgundy subdued (not alarm red). A small Esc hint near return button. Save/load are real menu ACTION LABELS in a visual concept, not a keybinding guide. Footer buttons same baseline, not cramped. No keyboard guide grid, no WASD, no inventory or currency. Beautiful restrained botanical fantasy, excellent UI hierarchy, readable functional modern layout dressed in artisan materials. This is an art proposal, not a screenshot of implemented functionality.
